# Lizzy's African Restaurant

> Authentic African foods in Richmond, Virginia. West African cooking with Ghanaian favorites such as jollof rice, waakye, fufu with egusi stew, banku with okro soup, light soup, attieke with fish and spicy khebab. Black-owned. Serving Richmond from Chamberlayne Road since October 2024.

## Key facts
- Name: Lizzy's African Restaurant
- Type: Restaurant (West African, Ghanaian, African)
- Address: 5310 Chamberlayne Rd, Richmond, VA 23227 (Chamberlayne Road corridor, North Richmond)
- Phone: (804) 716-4259 (call to order for pickup)
- Website: https://lizzys-african-restaurant-website.netlify.app/
- Black-owned: yes (listed on EatOkra, a directory of Black-owned businesses)
- Opened: October 8, 2024
- Google rating: 4.3 stars from 190 reviews

## Hours (Eastern Time)
- Monday: closed
- Tuesday to Saturday: 11 AM to 8 PM
- Sunday: 1 PM to 8 PM

## How to order
- Walk in during open hours and order at the counter
- Call (804) 716-4259 to order ahead for pickup
- Delivery on DoorDash: https://www.doordash.com/store/lizzy's-african-restaurant-richmond-32662293/
- Delivery on Grubhub: https://www.grubhub.com/restaurant/lizzys-african-restaurant-5310-chamberlayne-road-richmond/11192736

## Menu highlights and prices
Prices are delivery-app prices listed on DoorDash; in-store prices may differ.
- Jollof Rice w/ Chicken, Fish, Egg, Plantain: $18.99
- Waakye W/ Fish, Chicken, Egg, Plantains: $18.99
- Waakye W(2) Goat Meat, Egg, Sweet Plantains: $19.99
- Fufu With Goat Egusi Stew: $18.99
- Fufu With Chicken Stew: $17.99
- Banku With Okro Soup Goat Meat: $19.99
- Rice With Cassava Leaf Stew: $18.99

Menu sections: Fufu Egusi, Banku, Kenkey, Eba, Pounded Yam, Jollof, Waakye, Rice, Beans, Yam, Green Plantain, Atteke (attieke), Soup only, Stew, Chicken, Fried, Spicy Khebab, Eggs, Extras, Drinks (Non-Alcoholic), Dessert.

Dishes featured by the restaurant also include fried turkey wings, fried tilapia with attieke, light soup with goat, egusi stew, spicy khebab skewers, and boiled yam with fish in pepper stew, avocado and eggs.

Price guide: full plates are about $17.99 to $19.99 on DoorDash.

## FAQ
- Is Lizzy's open on Mondays? No. It is open Tuesday through Sunday.
- Does Lizzy's deliver? Yes, through DoorDash and Grubhub. You can also call to order for pickup.
- How much does a meal cost? Full plates are listed at $17.99 to $19.99 on DoorDash; in-store prices may differ.
- Can I walk in? Yes, during open hours.
- What should a first-timer order? A jollof or waakye plate is an easy start; fufu with goat egusi stew or banku with okro soup is the classic experience.
- Is the food spicy? Some soups and pepper sauces can be hot. Ask about spice when ordering.
- Is Lizzy's Black-owned? Yes, it is listed as a Black-owned business on EatOkra.
